admission.justification: Spans host catalog and create call: resolving provider/model/effort/speed against the catalog and carrying accepted fields onto the call is the core obligation of FAM-N17BB4's joint launch guarantee.

applicability: Every role-agent launch that carries host provider, model, effort or speed choices.
conditions: The host catalog names the offering being resolved.
Resolution runs before the actual create call.
exclusions: AR harness registry consumption, which stays its own consumer.
Dated candidate credits, which this invariant does not restate.
statement: Role launches resolve native provider, model, effort and speed choices against the host catalog and carry the accepted fields onto the actual create call; the AR harness registry remains its own consumer.
